title: Gaussian fields and interfaces for triangular-lattice Lipschitz heights

result.label: Gaussian fields and interfaces for triangular-lattice Lipschitz heights
result.statement: Proves Gaussian free field limits on bounded smooth simply connected domains for triangular-lattice height models: uniform odd heights with increments 0, 2 and two-arc boundary values 1, and zero-boundary integer Lipschitz heights weighted by fixed x [1/ 2,1]. Uniform real Lipschitz heights also converge to a Gaussian field; at a tuned opposite-boundary amplitude, their interface converges to chordal SLE 4 , establishing Schramm’s real-field/interface predictions.
